what_happened.line: The Planning Board held a hearing on draft earth removal and fill regulations, debating the exemption threshold, and asked members to send comments.
The board voted to nominate a member to the open space ad hoc committee, with no opposition heard.
The board discussed how to write a master plan RFP, including whether town meeting money can fund implementation as well as writing the plan.
The board agreed to put formation of a master plan committee and an Economic Development Committee on the August 12th agenda.
Earth removal comments are due by the 5th for a revised draft, to be discussed again August 12th; solar bylaw feedback follows on the 26th.

why_it_matters: The earth removal rules would set when digging or filling land needs board review, which touches neighbors of gravel and fill sites and landowners planning grading work.

The master plan funding choices decide how much of the town meeting money and expected grant goes to writing the plan versus carrying it out, which shapes future planning priorities and any related town meeting requests.
watch_next: August 12th Planning Board meeting: revised earth removal draft and formation of the master plan and Economic Development committees.
August 26th: board discussion of feedback on the solar bylaw.
